from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    mark = next(v for v in counts if v != background)
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == mark]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in points)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
        if out[r0][c] != mark: out[r0][c] = 2
        if out[r1][c] != mark: out[r1][c] = 2
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        if out[r][c0] != mark: out[r][c0] = 2
        if out[r][c1] != mark: out[r][c1] = 2
    return out
